name: playwright-e2e
description: Production-grade Playwright E2E testing against real public websites — demonstrating QA best practices.

scripts.test: npx bddgen -c playwright.bdd.config.ts && npx playwright test --config=playwright.bdd.config.ts
scripts.test:headed: npx bddgen -c playwright.bdd.config.ts && npx playwright test --config=playwright.bdd.config.ts --headed
scripts.test:smoke: npx bddgen -c playwright.bdd.config.ts && npx playwright test --config=playwright.bdd.config.ts --grep @smoke
scripts.report:allure: npx allure generate reports/allure/results --clean -o reports/allure/report && npx allure open reports/allure/report
